measurement_prerequisite_audit.preregistered_capture_rule: Freeze the human_speech_plan and required semantic groups before candidate inference.
measurement_prerequisite_audit.cause: The runner froze cognitive_tick logic before RightBrain.speak built and attached human_speech_plan, then built the model payload from that unaugmented logic.
measurement_prerequisite_audit.runtime_mismatch: Production _generate_model_surface_candidates returns no model candidate when the semantic contract is missing, but the formal runner called both models for all 30 cases.

descriptive_readout_under_incomplete_pay.bounded_observation: Qwen3.5 9B produced five more raw surface-gate passes and eight more required proposition hits than Qwen2.5 7B when both received the same incomplete payload. This is not evidence of an actual pipeline improvement.

validity_findings: The 3/30 semantic score for both models is driven by only four cases having a nonempty plan-derived semantic contract; 26 cases were structurally unable to pass that metric.
The reported model takeover counts include candidates from cases where production runtime would not invoke the model, so they are not production-representative.
The self-monitor received logic without human_speech_plan, raised missing_human_speech_plan, and replaced every production-eligible model candidate with a fallback reply.
The frozen automatic failure remains a valid safety stop, but it cannot be interpreted as a clean causal estimate of the 9B model replacement.

final_interpretation.supported: The current integration cannot authorize a 9B RightBrain replacement, human blind review, runtime shadow, or production rollout.
final_interpretation.not_supported: The artifacts do not establish that Qwen3.5 9B is worse than Qwen2.5 7B at plan-to-dialogue realization, nor that either model has a 10 percent true semantic success rate.
final_interpretation.primary_failure_location: LeftBrain-to-RightBrain contract capture and self-monitor integration in the evaluation harness.

next_experiment_requirements: Use entirely fresh cases; V61 cases are consumed and may not be rerun for a confirmatory claim.
Build and attach human_speech_plan before freezing the shared plan and before constructing either model payload.
Fail pre-inference unless every scored case has a nonempty semantic contract, or preregister an explicit eligible-only estimand and denominator.
Run the same production model-disabled check and the same self-monitor data shape used by live chat.
Prove with a negative control test that missing human_speech_plan aborts before any model call.
